design.target: power at a single future 15-minute interval endpoint, not the maximum over the next hour
design.event: target power >= training 95th percentile; statistical high load, not contractual demand limit
design.time_convention: interval endpoints, monthly [00:00, next boundary); final Sep15 00:00 omitted as in initial audit
design.features: strictly past power and target calendar only; no production/weather/staffing/same-hour mean
design.training: all eligible earlier observations, ending at first calibration forecast origin
design.calibration: previous month, labels ending at first test forecast origin; never refit on calibration
design.threshold: normal-calibration order statistic, alarm if score strictly greater; ties conservative
design.warning_budget: 1/3/5% empirical calibration-normal false alarm budget; test FPR may exceed it under drift
design.hgb: 180 iterations, 15 leaves, leaf min30, lr .06, l2=2, balanced sample weights, no early stopping, seed42
design.logistic: training-only StandardScaler, C1, class_weight balanced, max_iter2000, seed42
design.duplicate_audit: whole 96-value source-day hashes used only to stratify evaluation, never as a feature; new means first occurrence globally
design.known_test_exposure: Aug-Sep already viewed during topic selection; all new results are follow-up exploration, not a fresh blind confirmation
design.limitations: one supplied source, possible augmentation, no cost saving or physical fault/contract exceedance validation
